## Meridian KB Ingestion
Chunks the help-center Markdown, embeds each chunk with OpenAI (text-embedding-3-small, 1536), and upserts into Supabase `kb_documents`. Re-runnable and idempotent per article. Run this once before using the Support Copilot.

## Vector store
Inserts chunks + metadata (category/title/source) into pgvector via `match_kb_documents`. Retrieval is capped at top-5 at query time in the agent.
